modelOverview: The Yacht-Master 37 is the mid-size expression of Rolex's nautically-inspired sports line, blending the sailing heritage of the collection with a more compact 37mm Oyster case. It is defined by its bidirectional rotatable 60-minute bezel with raised polished numerals and a distinctive maritime aesthetic, offered in Rolesium and precious-metal configurations.

268622.movement: Automatic · Rolex Calibre 2236 · ~55h power reserve · Syloxi silicon hairspring
268622.materials: Oystersteel case and Oyster bracelet with 950 platinum bezel (Rolesium)
268622.bezel: Bidirectional rotatable 60-minute bezel in 950 platinum with raised polished numerals and graduations on a matt, sand-blasted background
268622.dial: Dark rhodium (slate) dial with applied hour markers and a turquoise-blue Yacht-Master seconds hand
268622.description: The Yacht-Master 37 reference 268622 is the Rolesium version, pairing an Oystersteel case and bracelet with a 950 platinum bezel. Its defining feature is the sand-blasted platinum bezel set against a dark rhodium dial with the signature turquoise seconds hand. Every example is sourced and independently authenticated.
